metadata.description: Distill the essence of any content into a prompt for imagery — still or moving. The 8 transformation principles (understand / select / translate / consistent / compose / style / negative / faithful) fold a whole text into the capacity of one generation, which the format card declares (one frame with no time axis / ten pages / thirty seconds at 16:9).

plugins.name: distill-essence-engine
plugins.description: Distill Essence Engine — turns any content (novel, article, poem, transcript, memo, paper …) into an English prompt for imagery, still or moving, via the transformation principles (understand → select → translate → consistent → compose → style → negative → faithful). Core quality = particular × indirect (show the truth, entrusted).
